Your everyday bank account: salary in, payments and withdrawals out. Record here the spending made with your debit or ATM card too: it draws straight from this account and has no balance of its own.

A fence around the money you set aside: fill it and dip into it with transfers from your main account. It counts toward the total balance but is excluded from the budget by default, so drawing on savings never consumes the month\'s budget. It also fits cash parked for investments: the app tracks the amount, not the quotes.
A card with its own balance, like a prepaid card: top it up with a transfer and spend straight from it.

For deferred cards charged once a month to the linked account. The balance starts at zero: if you already owe something on the current cycle, use "Adjust balance" after saving and it will be charged with the next statement.
The cash in your wallet. An ATM withdrawal is recorded as a transfer from the account to cash: it moves money, it is not an expense.
A digital wallet with its own balance (PayPal, Satispay, Revolut). If your wallet draws from your bank account without holding a balance, record the spending on the account instead.
Any other money container: meal vouchers, gift cards, a shared kitty.
